objective: Conditional SAFE/MARGINAL/UNSAFE probability/boundary maps with uncertainty, boundary attack traces and measurement priorities, not proof Facety works.

viability.status: predicate and estimands must be fixed in a real v2 registration before research

V3.name: honest-harm
components: honest access loss including unable-to-meet people

V4.name: honest-participation
V4.medianNetIncome: p*E - attention_cost >= 0; consistent units and type weights required

caveats: SAFE is conditional on model, searched attack language, beta, effort and thresholds, never real-world safety or unrestricted attacker optimality.
Do not conflate seed-level joint pass probability, V5 bad-event probability, finite-data confidence and surrogate uncertainty.
V5 is an across-seed probability criterion, not a per-replica Boolean.
Do not multiply marginal V1-V5 probabilities or average away a vulnerable attacker class.

reductions.priceWindow: p*E/w_threshold with all quantities normalized to the same daily units
reductions.growthApproximation: g_a ~ ln(2)/P is a proposed heuristic, not invitation service rate or a proven population law
reductions.servicePrior: min(1/P,E/b) under declared source/demand/phase conditions; record and investigate every deviation

environment.rangesStatus: unbound; each bound needs a source or no-basis label
environment.reservationWages: regional distribution w with time units and supplied labor/attention needs
environment.vigilanceLatencyFalseSuspicion: ranges and joint law, not calibrated points
environment.vouchSale: reservation prices and observed/acquired opportunities; no free consent
environment.alphaInterpretation: assumed model-form sensitivity, not significance alpha or measured exponent; old single-headline robustness gate no longer defines the map
environment.topology: licensed real social data where suitable; otherwise explicitly synthetic

method.activeRefinement: preregister uncertainty-driven point selection, stopping and budgets
method.scenarioDiscovery: PRIM/CART or equivalent; held-out theta coverage/density/accuracy
method.confirmation: reserved seeds AND held-out parameter points on both sides of the proposed boundary
method.sensitivity: Sobol or Morris on continuous outcomes; dependence assumptions explicit
method.voi: boundary displacement per justified uncertainty; formal VOI additionally needs priors, loss and decision
method.phase: channel-conditioned N*, duration below from genesis, collapse and failed-recovery distributions
method.crossCheck: independent core-equation reference versus full-simulator boundary; investigate mismatches before interpretation
method.ablationLadder: one mechanism at a time from an explicit minimal CORE; equal resources and equivalence/power before a no-effect kill nomination

outputs.M1: Probability viability maps in reduced groups,2D slices, compact conditions
outputs.M2: Arm dominance/Pareto map including honest-growth cost, treasury net benefit and safeguard flexibility; tie/scalarization rule must be registered
outputs.M3: Price/reservation-wage window including actual treasury purchasing power/paired-asset conditions; empty windows explicit
outputs.M4: Bootstrap N*/time-below/collapse map including governance shortage and small-N variants
outputs.M5: Sensitivity/VOI ranking including governance/signal/vendor/backing uncertainty and the pilot decision it changes
outputs.M6: Mechanism/safeguard/controller kill candidates from marginal map effect, not automatic selected-rule deletion
outputs.M7: Boundary unsafe attack traces including governance capture and measured-signal manipulation, with resources and outcomes
outputs.realityContract: Measurable SAFE-region preconditions/thresholds; unmeasurable terms are assumptions
outputs.decisionPacket: at most2 pages; no winning-rule or sensitivity recommendation before data

purchaseGovernance.status: proposal assumptions only; no policy engine, research data or new D-decision

treasury.scope: ARM_PURCHASE candidate only; no runtime/default protocol migration
contrastCandidates: initial s with identical adaptive-governance action space
treasury.settlementIdentity: treasury=s*q; burn=(1-s)*q; total=q for actual settled purchase q

adversary.name: governance capture
costVsValue: best-found successful cost and failed-attempt spend
conditional future-flow value with explicit valuation/horizon
net recoverable value, capture time/probability and honest harm

safeguards.matchedComparator: otherwise equal no-safeguard candidate; preregister combinations without implicit full factorial

controlLaw.appliesTo: bound PURCHASE b contract; no silent replacement of native own-source burn
controlLaw.attack: manipulate received signal up/down under real budget, distinct from genuine suppression change
metrics: signal bias and policy/harm/boundary shift per manipulation cost

benefit.requiredDemonstration: named purchased work/output improves effective response or honest outcomes after full opportunity/governance/capture cost
causalControls: explicitly funded matched-resource control/ablation where needed
benefit.pairedAssetRequirement: use-dependent; external payouts/cross-asset liquidity/buyback require actual funded counterpart asset, custody/execution and risk; no free backing or price floor
